title: Silver doped copper oxide decorated graphene oxide nanocomposite for electrochemical sensing, photocatalysis and biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43665-43675
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07285A, Paper

This study reports the fabrication of nanocomposite (Ag–CuO/GO), exhibits enhanced electrochemical sensing performance for biomolecule detection, superior photocatalytic degradation of organic pollutants, and notable antimicrobial activity.
